story.value: Berkelium was named after Berkeley, California, the city where it was discovered.
Berkelium was first produced by Stanley G. Thompson, Glenn T. Seaborg, Kenneth Street, Jr. and Albert Ghiorso.
The discoverers made berkelium by striking americium with alpha particles in a machine called a cyclotron.
